section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Eating Disorder Examination Questionnaire (EDE-Q), a 36-item self-report measure with four subscales (restraint, eating concern, shape concern, weight concern) used to assess eating pathology-related attitudes and behaviors. The text reports good psychometric properties for both original and Portuguese versions, with Cronbach's alpha values ranging from 0.77 to 0.95 in the present study. No study-specific demographic or outcome data is provided in this methodological description.
